character: Long, flowing former MotoGP circuit with a mix of high-speed sweeps and tighter technical corners, raced at night in the desert. Abrasive surface and sustained high-speed corners put a premium on tyre management.
sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2026/qatar/circuit — deliberately generic Turn-N labels (see comment above)
notes: Corner numbers only — deliberately avoids naming any corner ("Bit-Kurve" style errors have previously been hallucinated for this track). Character sourced from well-documented circuit facts (long, sweeping MotoGP-derived layout, desert night race).

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.type: heavy-braking corner off the main straight
corners.technique: Brake hard, late apex to set up the following sequence
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the technical section

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, manage tyre load through the sustained load
corners.trap: Overloading the tyre through a long high-speed corner and sliding wide late

corners.name: Turn 12
corners.technique: Late apex, patient throttle application on exit
corners.trap: Early throttle causing a slide on the tightening exit

corners.name: Turn 16
corners.type: final corner onto the pit straight
corners.technique: Clean exit is critical — feeds the run to the line
corners.trap: Compromised exit costs time down the entire straight
